card.name: Mid-sentence points in adverse-effect statements
card.fires_on: Scattered words and word parts inside label sentences that describe a reported effect, finding or association, such as a comma, 'that', 'was' or 'resulting' just before the outcome is stated.

modes.label: Linking words before a result
modes.description: A comma or linking word right before the outcome of a reaction, interaction or study is given.

modes.description: Partway through a long medical term for a side effect or a brand name.
